dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 07, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Braves Edge Pirates in Thrilling Finish**

The Atlanta Braves outlasted the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2 in a nail-biting contest, thanks in large part to a strong outing from Bubba Chandler. Chandler tossed 5.1 innings, striking out seven and surrendering just two earned runs. Reynaldo López earned the win for the Braves, while Didier Fuentes secured the save. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with a pair of hits, including a home run, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Braves' pitching prowess.

**Phillies Rout White Sox Behind Power-Hitting Lineup**

The Philadelphia Phillies flexed their muscles in a 9-5 thrashing of the Chicago White Sox, with eight different players contributing at least one hit. Brandon Marsh went deep for the Phillies, driving in two runs. Jonathan Bowlan turned in a strong relief performance, striking out three in two innings of work. Tyler Davis took the loss for the White Sox.

**Yankees Cruise Past Red Sox Behind Strong Suarez Performance**

The New York Yankees cruised to a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, thanks in large part to a dominant outing from Ranger Suarez. Suarez tossed 6.1 innings, fanning six and allowing just one earned run. Jazz Chisholm Jr. homered for the Yankees, driving in three runs. Justin Slaten took the loss for the Red Sox.
